origin.thida.thida.name: Thida
origin.thida.thida.description: A keeper of Narotra and Nilakan bonds, shared pain, heart covenants and a charm domain.
power.thida.arts.name: Arts of Thida
power.thida.arts.description: Link Narotra by gazing for 10 seconds to restore mana and cleanse Thida's debuffs. Link Nilakan by attacking to gain speed and melee damage while cleansing Thida's debuffs. Keep either doll in your inventory; hold it, open the doll menu (R by default; rebind in Controls), and press 1 to unlink. Thida's other powers continue to work as before.
death.attack.thida.shared.player: %1$s died from shared pain while fighting %2$s
item.thida.parasite_doll.desc: Right click to summon, then hit to link; right click again to cancel
item.thida.nilakan_doll.desc: Granted when choosing the Thida Origin, craftable, or available with /thida kit. Hold the doll and hit a player within 10 blocks (line of sight is not required) to link one target. While linked: +5% movement speed and melee damage; cleanses Thida's debuffs every 10 minutes. Keep the doll anywhere in your inventory. Use Open straw-doll menu, then press 1 to unlink.
item.thida.domain_talisman.desc: Right click: stationary 30-block domain for 5 min, then 20 min cooldown
item.thida.heart_doll.desc: Aim at a player and right click to protect their heart
item.thida.narotra_doll.desc: Granted when choosing the Thida Origin, craftable, or available with /thida kit. Hold the doll and gaze at a player within 15 blocks with clear line of sight for 10 seconds to link. Bond range: 200 blocks. Restores 5% Max Mana to both players on link and every 20 seconds (per-player rate does not stack); cleanses Thida's debuffs every 20 minutes. Keep the doll anywhere in your inventory. Use Open straw-doll menu, then press 1 to unlink.
item.thida.retired: Retired power. This legacy item has no ability.
